constellations.summary: Dominant Hydro beam DPS channeling continuous AoE damage across the entire battlefield.
Grants full interruption resistance during Charged Attack beam channeling and gives 1 free Past Draconic Glories stack.
Increases CRIT DMG of Equitable Judgment by up to 42% based on Draconic Glories stacks.
Increases Normal Attack talent level by 3 (his primary beam scaling!).
Generates 1 additional Sourcewater Droplet when receiving healing while on-field.
Continuously absorbs nearby droplets to extend beam channeling duration indefinitely and fires two secondary torrents.

weapons.name: Tome of the Eternal Flow
weapons.reasoning: Signature catalyst. Grants +16% Max HP, +42% Charged Attack DMG, and refunds 8 Energy upon HP fluctuation.

weapons.name: Sacrificial Jade
weapons.reasoning: Battle Pass weapon giving +36.8% CRIT Rate, up to +64% Max HP, and 80 EM when off-field for 5s.

weapons.name: Prototype Amber
weapons.reasoning: Craftable catalyst providing +41.3% HP, restoring 18 Energy and healing the entire party for 18% Max HP on Burst.

weapons.name: Ash-Graven Drinking Horn
weapons.reasoning: Natlan event catalyst giving high HP% and dealing AoE damage based on 80% of Max HP.

weapons.name: Lost Prayer to the Sacred Winds
weapons.reasoning: Provides +33.1% CRIT Rate, +10% Movement Speed, and stacking Elemental DMG bonus.

artifactSets.reasoning: +15% Charged Attack DMG and +36% free CRIT Rate as Neuvillette constantly drains and heals HP during beam channeling.
+15% Hydro DMG and +30% Charged Attack DMG after casting Skill.
